blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval stone arched sewer grate or drainage culvert. It features a rounded masonry arch with distinct voussoirs and side pillars framing four vertical rusted metal bars. A dark flat backing fills the space behind the bars, and bright green moss or toxic slime drips down from the base of the grate opening onto the lower stone sill. The backside mirrors the arched stonework framing a solid dark interior surface.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular strip showing the top segmented stone blocks of the arch, flanked by subtle lower profile projections.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall (about half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 feet wide.
